Callout.Name: Overdose - Young Person
Callout.Message: Young person unresponsive at a party.
Callout.Advisory: Breathing shallow, friends present and frightened.

Script.Line: It is my friend. She took something at the party.
I do not know what it was. Nobody at that party knows what it was.
Is she awake? Just tell me if she is awake.

Callout.Patient: I did not think it would do that. Is she awake?

Lines.Approach: Shallow breathing and a room full of frightened teenagers. Get to her and keep the questions for later.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
